title: Text message thread (phone screenshot)
description: A screenshot of a phone messaging thread. 'in' bubbles are from the contact named at the top, 'out' bubbles are from the phone's owner. Write like real texting: short, lowercase, typos, several bubbles in a row.

fromLabel.description: Contact name shown at the top of the thread

contactInitials.description: Letters in the contact's avatar (defaults to initials of fromLabel)

statusTime.description: Clock in the phone status bar

batteryPercent.description: Battery level drawn in the status bar

unreadCount.description: Unread badge next to the back arrow

dateLabel.description: Timestamp separator above the first bubble

dir.description: in = from the contact, out = from the phone owner

examples: all the screens say flight 666 to purgatory lol

timeLabel.description: Optional timestamp separator shown before this bubble

receipt.description: Status under the last outgoing bubble
